verdict.rationale: The evidence shows serving: deploying on Inference Endpoints, uploading model weights to a repo, and a generic 'run a job on Hugging Face infrastructure' command. Nothing documents a fine-tuning capability that trains a supported base model on user data. Generic compute jobs are a developer building block, not the fine-tune-and-serve workflow itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can fine-tune a supported base model on my own data and serve the result on the same platform
